headline: Technical fabrics built for four workouts a week
body: Gear up with high-performance activewear crafted from recycled ocean plastic. Designed to keep pace with your toughest training sessions without compromising on sweat-wicking support.
rationale: This copy directly addresses The Fitness Enthusiast by leaning into their high-frequency workout schedule and desire for technical fabrics, while completely avoiding fashion-only framing or sedentary messaging.
